mapper.sql: id, channel, external_approval_id, resource_type, resource_code, workspace_id, project_code, title, description, submit_remark, ext_data, status, stage_chain, current_stage, decision_rule, required_count, resolved_at, expires_at, withdrawn_at, withdrawn_reason, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at
mapper.select: select from t_r_approval_record where external_approval_id = #{externalApprovalId} limit 1

select r.id, r.channel, r.external_approval_id, r.resource_type, r.resource_code, r.workspace_id, r.project_code, r.title, r.description, r.submit_remark, r.ext_data, r.status, r.stage_chain, r.current_stage, r.decision_rule, r.required_count, r.resolved_at, r.expires_at, r.withdrawn_at, r.withdrawn_reason, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_at, u.username as created_by_username, w.name as workspace_name from t_r_approval_record r left join t_r_user u on u.id = r.created_by left join t_r_workspace w on w.id = r.workspace_id where r.id = #{id}
select id from t_r_approval_record where status = 'PENDING' and expires_at is not null and expires_at < #{now} order by expires_at asc limit #{limit}
